archimate:ValueStream.name: VS-10.5 Engage and Communicate with Stakeholders
archimate:ValueStream.documentation:
Beyond service delivery, the organization must actively engage and communicate. This means going beyond data provision to create real understanding and collaboration. Regular newsletters, webinars, conferences, and social media are used to share updates, explain new methods, and promote transparency about ongoing projects. Workshops and user forums are organized to discuss needs and co-create solutions. Feedback mechanisms are kept open so that stakeholders can continuously contribute to improving services. This two-way engagement strengthens the organization’s role as a trusted, responsive, and visible public institution.
Value created: Strong, transparent communication that builds understanding, collaboration, and trust.
